title: Going Shopping
description: Unit VI — shops and money: naming the shops of the town and the goods they sell, asking politely with Would like, asking and giving a price with How much is it? It's…, the numbers up to the hundreds, the simple past of the shopping day (regular -ed and the irregular verbs of the shop), the clothes shop and trying clothes on, the two corners of in and on, and the two sounds of jeans and garage
sources: Learn and Grow — Year 6 Basic Education, Teacher's Guide (CNP 541608P00), Unit VI "Going Shopping", pages 51-58 (lessons 1-5 and Progress Check 6, p.58)
